##Q1
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)

df <- read_csv(
  "https://bryantstats.github.io/math421/data/ds_salaries.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

head(df)
 
```

##Q2
```{r}
colSums(is.na(df))
 
```

##Q3
```{r}
df %>%
  count(job_title, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(1)
 
```

##Q4
```{r}
df %>%
  count(job_title, sort = TRUE) %>%
  head(3) %>%
  select(job_title) %>%
  left_join(df, by = "job_title") %>%
  group_by(job_title) %>%
  summarise(
    average_salary = mean(salary_in_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(average_salary))
 
```

##Q5
```{r}
df %>%
  group_by(job_title) %>%
  summarise(
    average_salary = mean(salary_in_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(average_salary)) %>%
  head(1)
 
```

##Q6
```{r}
df %>%
  group_by(company_location) %>%
  summarise(
    average_salary = mean(salary_in_usd, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(average_salary)) %>%
  head(1)
 
```

##Q7
```{r}
ggplot(df, aes(x = salary_in_usd)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  labs(title = "Salary Distribution",
       x = "Salary (USD)",
       y = "Count",
       caption = "Data Science Salaries")

ggplot(df, aes(x = experience_level, y = salary_in_usd)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Salary by Experience Level",
       x = "Experience Level",
       y = "Salary (USD)",
       caption = "Data Science Salaries")

ggplot(df, aes(x = experience_level)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Jobs by Experience Level",
       x = "Experience Level",
       y = "Count",
       caption = "Data Science Salaries")

ggplot(df, aes(x = company_size, y = salary_in_usd)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(title = "Salary by Company Size",
       x = "Company Size",
       y = "Salary (USD)",
       caption = "Data Science Salaries")

ggplot(df, aes(x = employment_type)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(title = "Jobs by Employment Type",
       x = "Employment Type",
       y = "Count",
       caption = "Data Science Salaries")
 
```
